selected_scope: Tab5 app-only successor 0.68: retain 0.67 multiplayer join/leave/rejoin, asynchronous video, on-demand scores, remote debug and audio behavior. Promote parity-proven Doom startup texture metadata range reads, per-file WAD validation phase timing, neutral empty gamepad broker handling, lazy wall setup, early off-axis sprite culling and aligned four-pixel palette expansion. Update version-only shell frame hashes and exact vendored-source provenance. Preserve toolchain, board pins, flash layout, protected content lineage, native game packages, recovery images, WAD identity and canonical tic/transport contracts. Runtime acceptance must measure both exact A/B installations, active cadence >=25 FPS (aim30), guest return to ongoing host, overlay clearing and music/effects. Global doom-provenance target retains existing failure for unchanged tracked game-data/pure-hades/v0.6/PUREHADES.WAD; source verifier independently passes205 pinned files. Mixed renderer proof240 exact frames/world/RNG; inherited r_data negative-shift UB reproduces baseline so that legacy TU uses ASan-only in this proof. No checkpoint integration or WAD/content change in this image.
